file: 01 - I turn this outdated landing page
text: I turn this outdated SaaS landing page into a modern, conversion-focused experience.

The first problem? The hero section was overloaded with information, making the product's core value proposition difficult to understand. The second problem? Lengthy problem sections made the content difficult to scan and understand. And finally, the features section didn't have proper structure or visual separation.

To solve these problems, here's what I changed. First, I simplified the hero with clearer messaging and a product demo video. Next, I transformed lengthy explanations into three simple, visually engaging problem cards. Finally, I introduced a dedicated VibeLevel Screening section with clearly structured product features.
And here's the final transformation. This is the before, and this is the after. That's how I turn SaaS websites into conversion-focused experiences.
